property_summary: For any admissible inputs to initialize, the reference contract stores the supplied _feeRate into feeRate (so c.feeRate() == _feeRate after initialize), whereas the mutant clamps feeRate to zero (so for some nonzero _feeRate the stored value differs).
change_summary: Clamp the provided _feeRate to zero before storing, so feeRate will always be 0 after initialize regardless of input.
